topic: stop blossom end rot on tomatoes
core_question: How do I stop the bottoms of my tomatoes from rotting? (secondary: How do I clean my camera lens without scratching the glass?)
answer_summary: Maintain even, consistent soil moisture (mulching helps) so the plant can properly take up calcium, which corrects blossom end rot.; after the topic shift: Remove loose particles with a rocket blower or soft brush first, then wipe in gentle circular motions with a microfiber lens cloth or lens tissue, using a drop of lens cleaning solution for smudges — never a shirt or paper towel.
